frozen_prior_result.rule: The prior result is immutable and cannot be reclassified by this diagnostic.

purpose: Determine whether the observed whole-episode effect is arithmetically concentrated on axes that I4H was designed to improve while protected semantic/continuity axes remain nonloss. This is mechanism attribution only, not a new efficacy claim.

axis_partition_frozen_before_diagnostic.basis: Derived from the already-preregistered I4H/I4I mechanism: LOW targets physicalized subtext; STANDARD targets exposition/procedure and pacing; protection rules preserve voice/social/relationship/thread/temporal/long-horizon state. Partition is frozen before computation and may not be changed after seeing the diagnostic output.

metrics: mean and minimum delta of protection_axes
exact weighted reconstruction of the 12-axis overall delta
mean scene-craft delta among intervened scenes
interpretation_rules: If target-axis mean is positive and every protection axis is nonloss, classify MECHANISM_CONSISTENT_WITH_CONSERVATIVE_SURFACE_EFFECT.
If any protection axis is negative, classify PROTECTION_CONCERN.
No result from this diagnostic changes the I4I R1 FAIL or any authority/promotion state.
No threshold may be changed because of this diagnostic.
